title: What Lies 8,000 Meters Deep in the Bermuda Triangle?
description:
What actually lies deep beneath the Bermuda Triangle? 8,300 meters down, extreme ocean physics and hidden mantle geology replace folklore.

Beneath the southern Atlantic edge lies the Puerto Rico Trench, a dark chasm where lost ships vanished beyond human reach. Surface physics explains the danger: the warm Gulf Stream collides with Atlantic storms to unleash 30-meter rogue waves capable of overwhelming steel cargo vessels in minutes.

USGS records disprove gas-hydrate blowouts over the last 15,000 years. Instead, seismologists discovered a 20-kilometer-thick layer of frozen mantle rock underplating the crust—a geological raft elevating the seafloor by 500 meters.

🔔 Subscribe for daily strange science: https://www.youtube.com/@proofofwonderscience?sub_confirmation=1
▶️ Watch more Proof of Wonder Shorts: https://www.youtube.com/@proofofwonderscience/shorts

Which surprised you more: the 8,300-meter deep abyss or the hidden 20-km rock raft?
